display.title: Episode 279: I Love Hashem (After Shavuos)
display.summary_short: After Shavuos: Hashem gives the Torah anew every day, plans for a Torah-filled summer, music returns with the Hakochainik march, a guest's storm adventure, and a boy's lesson from a mirror.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week after Shavuos 5747. Uncle Yossi recalls hearing the Ten Commandments together in shul, saying Tehillim for Dovid HaMelech's yahrzeit and the all-night Tikkun Leil Shavuos. Every morning we say 'Nosein HaTorah', Who gives the Torah, because Hashem gives it to us anew each day. With summer vacation coming, children should set daily times for davening and learning, and choose a Jewish day camp or overnight camp; he also reminds them to mail in their Shavuos mitzvah charts. Now that Sefirah is over, the music returns: he teaches how to keep a four-beat rhythm for the Hakochainik march. A seven-year-old yeshiva boy recites the Shema and tells how his family's rowboat was caught in a thunderstorm, when they said the brachos on lightning and thunder and trusted Hashem. Story time: Berel shows his mother the lesson his Rebbe taught with a mirror, following the Baal Shem Tov's teaching that we learn from everything: smile and the mirror smiles back, so serve Hashem with joy, and Hashem shines back at you. The show ends with the song 'I Love Hashem'.
display.lesson: Serve Hashem with joy: like a mirror, the happy face you show is the one that shines back at you.
